notes: Flasher(transport, chunk_size, max_attempts, backoff_s, sleep): raise ValueError if chunk_size or max_attempts is below 1. flash(image) raises ValueError("empty image") for empty bytes before touching the transport. Each attempt: connect(), write the image in chunk_size pieces, then verify() must equal hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest(), otherwise raise ChecksumMismatch("checksum mismatch"). close() is called exactly once after every successful connect, even when a write or verify fails, and never when connect fails. TransportError (including ChecksumMismatch) is retried: after failed attempt k, call sleep(backoff_s * 2 ** (k - 1)), but never after the last attempt. When all attempts fail, raise FlashError(f"gave up after {max_attempts} attempts: {last error}") (the message is checked) chained from the last error with raise ... from. Any other exception propagates immediately with no retry. Return the number of attempts used. Use the injected sleep, never time.sleep directly. FakeTransport and exercise are provided.
